findings.message: A frame is cut short by the next frame's sync word, first at 0x600: their header or data is damaged, or bytes are missing.
A frame is larger than the targeted bit rate allows: 768 bytes where 512 fit the targeted 384 kbit/s; 5.4.2 says the targeted rate is at least the actual one. First in the frame at 0x600 (once).
